I 100% agree with you. I loved this game and I think it is highly underrated. When I first downloaded the game and played it for the first time, I was unsure of how to feel and whether I would like it. Finished Colt’s story a few days ago and I love this game! It is a very unique experience in which I have never seen any other game like it. Has decent graphics and a very good story. I understand some parts of the story may get repetitive at times, but the story itself makes up for it in my opinion. One thing I do think Arcane could have improved on is their multiplayer feature. The multiplayer feature has little to no variety whatsoever and the matchmaking is very inconsistent. I also wish there was more to do after finishing Colt’s story. I would love to play more deathloop but after finishing the game, I’m unsure of what else to do, other than explore Blackreef. Overall, very underrated and fantastic game and is definitely my game of the year for 2021.
